title: Check in
description: A late flight, a cheap hotel, a briefing at nine.
hint: The night clerk is at the desk.

title: Go up to room 304
description: The elevator is out. The stairs are past the bar.
hint: Past the bar, up the stairs to the third floor.

title: Get some sleep
hint: The bed is by the window.

title: Answer the door
description: Someone is knocking. Whatever is outside, Leon is not opening it empty-handed.
hint: There is a steel flask on the table.

title: Follow Ortiz
description: Out of the room and down to the garage.
hint: She is heading for the stairwell.

title: Get to the garage unseen
description: Down the stairs, through the lobby, into the garage. If they see you, break their line of sight and let them forget.
hint: The garage door is behind the front desk.

title: Find bay 14
description: The bureau car is somewhere on level P2. The key fob chirps when you are close.
hint: Bays 12 to 16 are the reserved row on the far wall.

title: Drive to the field office
description: Kestrel Street. The roads are blocked with wrecks, and the strong ones run at the car.
hint: Keep your speed up. Go round the wrecks, not through them.

title: Read the night desk log
description: Ruth kept a log all night.
hint: It is on the front desk.
